name: MaLeDB · Mahjong
description: Four-player Chinese Mahjong with local computer opponents, fan scoring, a celadon table, sounds, hints and saved games.

versions.releaseNotes: Initial store candidate: one human and three local computer players, chi/peng/kong/hu, native fan scoring, flowers, hints, auto-play, sounds, pause and saved games. macOS Apple Silicon; Simplified Chinese UI. Fixed room rules are documented in the source README.

zh-CN.name: 麻了DB
zh-CN.description: 写麻了？摸两张。青瓷牌桌、三位电脑牌友，支持吃碰杠胡、番型计分、音效动效、提示托管与本地续局。
